# Exact GO:0006915 human and mouse snapshot

Fetched from the QuickGO annotation API on 2026-09-30 with
[`fetch_go0006915.py`](fetch_go0006915.py), using `goId=GO:0006915`,
`goUsage=exact`, and `taxonId` set to either human `9606` or mouse `10090`.
Descendant annotations were deliberately excluded so this is only the broad
top-level `apoptotic process` row set.

## Generated files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| [go0006915/metadata.json](go0006915/metadata.json) | Fetch timestamp, QuickGO endpoint, query settings, and row counts |
| [go0006915/human-go0006915.tsv](go0006915/human-go0006915.tsv) | Normalized human QuickGO rows |
| [go0006915/mouse-go0006915.tsv](go0006915/mouse-go0006915.tsv) | Normalized mouse QuickGO rows |
| [go0006915/human-go0006915-symbol-rollup.tsv](go0006915/human-go0006915-symbol-rollup.tsv) | Human rows collapsed by displayed symbol |
| [go0006915/mouse-go0006915-symbol-rollup.tsv](go0006915/mouse-go0006915-symbol-rollup.tsv) | Mouse rows collapsed by displayed symbol |
| [go0006915/human-mouse-go0006915-symbol-rollup.tsv](go0006915/human-mouse-go0006915-symbol-rollup.tsv) | Combined human and mouse symbol rollup |
| [go0006915/human-go0006915-raw.json](go0006915/human-go0006915-raw.json) | Raw paginated QuickGO payloads for human |
| [go0006915/mouse-go0006915-raw.json](go0006915/mouse-go0006915-raw.json) | Raw paginated QuickGO payloads for mouse |

To refresh the snapshot from the repository root:

```sh
uv run projects/APOPTOSIS/fetch_go0006915.py
```

## Snapshot size

| Taxon | Exact GO:0006915 rows | Symbols |
|---|---:|---:|
| human | 825 | 345 |
| mouse | 557 | 238 |

Rows are not unique biological assertions. The human `TP53` block alone has
103 rows because broad InterPro IEA rows are repeated over many UniProt
accessions and isoforms; the symbol rollups are therefore a better worklist
view than the raw rows.

## Evidence-code mix

| Taxon | IEA | IDA | IMP | IGI | IPI | IBA | ISO | ISS | TAS | NAS | RCA | ISA |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| human | 530 | 44 | 37 | 4 | 2 | 28 | 0 | 7 | 106 | 67 | 0 | 0 |
| mouse | 256 | 21 | 99 | 10 | 0 | 26 | 97 | 28 | 4 | 1 | 14 | 1 |

Human exact rows are dominated by electronic sources, chiefly InterPro and
UniProt IEA imports. Mouse has a larger experimental fraction because MGI
contributes many IMP rows from survival/death-readout genetics; those are the
rows most likely to need an over-annotation check before accepting a generic
`GO:0006915` assertion.

## Already reviewed APOPTOSIS targets

The current Priority 1 human review set still covers 132 exact top-level rows:
`FAS` 18, `CASP8` 14, `DIABLO` 14, `BCL2L1` 11, `DFFB` 10, `APAF1` 8,
`CASP9` 8, `DFFA` 6, `CASP3` 5, `FASLG` 5, `BAX` 4, `BCL2` 4, `CASP7` 4,
`CASP6` 3, `PMAIP1` 3, `AIFM1` 2, `BAK1` 2, `BCL2L11` 2, `CASP10` 2,
`BBC3` 1, `CFLAR` 1, `FADD` 1, `TNFRSF10A` 1, `TNFRSF10B` 1, `TNFRSF1A` 1,
and `TNFSF10` 1.

The mouse over-annotation slice covered three symbols with exact top-level rows:
`Bcl2` 9, `Casp3` 9, and `Tnfrsf1a` 1. The broader mouse rollup points to
`Casp9`, `Bad`, `Dap3`, `Ripk1`, `Casp8`, `Col6a1`, `Diablo`, and `Bcl2l1` as
the next reviewed-gene comparators if this project continues the mouse branch.
